answer: A decaying identity bond drives a sybil swarm to its nadir: each identity locks 500 POA losing 5% per epoch unless the agent completes real tasks, so fakes melt away. Below 100 POA the identity freezes until topped up, and honest agents re-earn the decay from task fees. To forge 1,000 fake identities costs 500,000 POA locked at once, while one honest agent pays a single 500 POA bond. Crossing a tundra ruins a swarm, not one traveller.
